text:
harper: Quick follow-up from INC-2026 postmortem. We need a compact runbook page + automation hooks for the KV eviction recurrence. Goal: owners, exact runbook diffs, and a short testplay for the oncall to run.

jon: I can own the runbook edits and the testplay script. Will make a PR with diffs and a smoke-test by Thu.

felix: I'll own alert tuning and adding the deploy-correlation tag. Also will add a dashboard widget showing per-customer eviction share. ETA Tue.

harper: Good. Runbook must include: 1) triage checklist, 2) exact commands (dry-run + commit), 3) decision rule for per-customer throttle vs global evict, 4) PD ladder.

jon: Draft triage commands to include in PR:```bash
# inspect eviction events (last 12m)
rictl logs svc/inference --since 12m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")'
# shard hit ratio (5m)
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --dry-run
# commit manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --confirm
# quick canary rotate
opsctl rotate canary --service=inference --timeout=5m
```

felix: Add a pre-check step: detect if >65% evictions map to a single api_key and if so run `proxyctl throttle --api-key <key> --rate 5r/s` and notify CS. Otherwise proceed with global evict.

harper: Also include an automated testplay (one-liner) responders can run that simulates eviction detection and validates alert-to-pager path. Jon add that to the PR.

jon: Will add smoke test: `./scripts/testplay/kv-evict-smoke.sh --dry-run` which hits the alert pipeline and verifies PD trigger. Will document expected outputs.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Draft playbook created: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/kv-evict-compact - owners: jon (runbook+testplay), felix (monitoring).

felix: For alerts, I'll create a composite rule: (KV_EVICT_RATE > 0.4% over 5m) OR (KV_HIT_RATIO drop > 12% over 5m). Include `recent_deploy=true` tag if a deploy happened <30m.

harper: PD ladder: oncall -> infra lead @15m -> SRE pager @30m -> region-fallback @45m. Include an explicit step to start canary rotate at 10m. Felix please encode timings in PD entries.

jon: Timeline recap: PR with runbook diffs + testplay by Thu EOD. Felix alert + dashboard by Tue. I'll open a GH issue to link PR, PD entries, and postmortem.

felix: I'll also add a runbook pointer in the alert payload so responders have one-click access to the playbook and the incident PM doc.

harper: Great. I'll check in next Monday to confirm merge and testplay green. If anything blocks, raise here and we'll reassign. :white_check_mark:
